description: This Java class defines the 'AclModified' event in the Eclipse Ditto framework, indicating that a Thing's Access Control List (ACL) was modified. It includes constructors, JSON serialization/deserialization, and accessor methods relevant to this specific event type.

classes.name: AclModified
classes.description: An event class representing the modification of a Thing's Access Control List (ACL). It supports construction from JSON, cloning with different revision or headers, and provides access to the ACL data.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory methods to create instances of AclModified with various parameters including ThingId, AccessControlList, revision, timestamp, headers, and metadata.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an AclModified instance from a JSON string or JSON object, given the event headers.

methods.name: getAccessControlList
methods.description: Returns the AccessControlList associated with this event.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the JSON representation of the ACL, based on schema version.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer resource path for the ACL in the event payload.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Creates a copy of the event with a different revision number.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Creates a copy of the event with different Ditto headers.

methods.name: appendPayloadAndBuild
methods.description: Appends the ACL data to a JSON object builder for serialization.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Calculates the hash code for the object, including the ACL.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on class type, ACL, and superclass equality.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the event, including the ACL.
